blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.
I'd like to be called Yanni.
Yanni was the one who called.
Ziri called Rima to help him.

blocks.note: كان ينبغي على سامي أن يتّصل بليلى.

blocks.text: Please tell John that I called.
blocks.note: بلغ جون أني اتصلت من فضلك.

blocks.text: You were the one who called me.
Yanni called out Skura's name again.
Sami called Layla to come and get him.
blocks.note: اتّصل سامي بليلى، طالبا منها أن تأتي و تصطحبه.

blocks.text: When was the last time you called Mary?

Can I go out to play?
Play where I can see you.
Why doesn't he play with me anymore?
